def matrix_free_spectral_embedding(
    counts: np.ndarray,
    n_components: int,
    random_state: int = 0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""
    # validation
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")
    if (counts.sum(axis=1) == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("all-zero rows not allowed")
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1")

    # IDF scaling
    df = np.count_nonzero(counts, axis=0)
    idf = np.log(n_cells / (1 + df))
    X = counts * idf.reshape(1, -1)

    # Row normalization
    norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    X = X / norms

    # Linear operator for W = X X^T - I
    def matvec(v):
        return X @ (X.T @ v) - v

    n = n_cells
    A = LinearOperator((n, n), matvec=matvec, dtype=X.dtype)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.randn(n).astype(X.dtype)

    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(A, k=n_components, which='LA', v0=v0, return_eigenvectors=True)
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
